documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Upcoming Board Meeting Of The Company.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: RBZ Jewellers Limited reported an operational revenue of INR 1,208 Mn and EBITDA of INR 180 Mn for Q1 FY27, with revenue increasing by approximately 60% year-on-year. Management highlighted retail expansion plans with new flagship showrooms in Surat and Rajkot, and mid-sized stores in Maninagar and Gandhinagar. The company continues to experience strong performance driven by customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and brand recall across its retail, wholesale, and job-work segments. Additionally, manufacturing capacity utilization targets and expansion strategies remain on track as outlined in the investor presentation. RBZ Jewellers reported a 20% year-on-year revenue growth for FY26, with EBITDA margins expanding to 14.44%.

guidance.claim: Management stated a target for maximum utilization of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26.
guidance.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue increased by approximately 60% year-on-year, driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue increased by ~60% year-on-year, driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.

demand_outlook.claim: Management is observing market reactions to recent gold import restrictions and price increases before providing concrete outlooks.
demand_outlook.quote: I don't have my comments on this until and unless there is something really concrete to tell you.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continues to see steady consumer demand in the occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to witness steady consumer demand in occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season, while also optimizing our inventory mix with a greater focus on lightweight and budget-friendly product offering to cater to evolving consumer preference.

capex_expansion.claim: Retail expansion remains on track, with flagship showrooms in Surat and Rajkot, alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar and Gandhinagar.
capex_expansion.quote: Retail expansion remains on track, with flagship showrooms in Surat (by Q2) and Rajkot (by early Q3), alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar (Ahmedabad East) and Gandhinagar, aimed at strengthening geographic presence and enhancing direct customer access across high-growth Gujarat markets.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to open new showrooms in Surat and Rajkot by the second quarter of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is exploring locations in Eastern Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, we are actively exploring strategic location in Eastern Ahmedabad and nearby cities such as Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet and aimed at strengthening the regional presence and driving incremental growth.

margins_costs.claim: Retail gross margins are approximately 12% to 14%, while wholesale and B2B margins are lower.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, retail would be around 12% or 14% GP. Wholesale will be around 7% to 8% GP. B2B will be around 6% to 7% and 8% GP.

orders_capacity.claim: Current manufacturing capacity utilization is approximately 50% to 55%.
orders_capacity.quote: The capacity utilization is approximately 50% or 55%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company launched 730 new designs during the quarter, averaging 8 designs per day.
orders_capacity.quote: During the quarter, we launched 730 new designs averaging 8 designs per day, primarily in occasion wear segment further strengthening our product portfolio

capital_allocation.claim: The company targets a debt-to-equity ratio between 1:1 and 1.5:1 for the current fiscal year.
Management expects to fund new store inventory through a combination of debt, inventory transfer, and profits.
capital_allocation.quote: No. I think the raise of debt plus inventory transfer, plus the profit gain would actually suffice it.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management acknowledged that recent government restrictions on gold imports are not advantageous.
risks_headwinds.quote: Certainly, I think these restrictions are not advantageous, but up to what level there is an impact is crucial.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to achieve maximum utilization of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26.
management_commitments.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26

management_commitments.claim: Surat and Rajkot showrooms are targeted to commence operations by Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.
